title: Course management back office (React 19)
titleZh: 冰草约课 · 课程管理后台（React 19）
summary: The Bingcao Studio course back office implemented with React 19 Hooks, Pling scope and record hooks, one shared agent-first task runtime, and a guide inside a fused assistant sidebar.
summaryZh: 用 React 19 Hooks 实现的冰草约课课程管理后台：通过 Pling 的 scope、record Hook 声明页面，复用同一套 agent-first 任务运行时，并在融合侧栏的聊天中展示引导。

guide.title: Hooks for the page, one runtime for the work
guide.titleZh: 页面用 Hook，执行仍只有一套运行时
intro: The React page owns rendering and hook lifecycles. Task definitions, lookups, conflicts, activity evidence, and execution still come from the shared course management back-office runtime.
React 19 runs in an isolated Vite entry so the React 16.3 compatibility demo can keep using its own runtime without either page loading two copies of React.
introZh: React 页面负责渲染与 Hook 生命周期；任务定义、查找、冲突、操作证据与执行仍来自共享的课程管理后台运行时。
React 19 使用独立的 Vite 入口构建，这样 React 16.3 兼容示例可以保留自己的运行时，两个页面都不会加载两份 React。

steps.title: Create one root runtime
steps.body: The entry creates Pling once and mounts the provider around the application. The demo keeps the 100-turn limit and enables the debug log.
steps.bodyZh: 入口只创建一次 Pling，并在应用外层挂载 Provider。演示保持 100 轮上限并开启调试日志。

steps.title: Expose a read-only view
steps.body: usePlingState exposes the students, teachers, and schedule snapshot. Writes still go through declared actions, never through a state setter.
steps.bodyZh: usePlingState 暴露学员、老师与课表快照；写入仍然只经过声明动作，不通过 state setter。

steps.title: Attach scope and record hooks
steps.titleZh: 附着 scope 与 record Hook
steps.body: The page marks each business region and record. The assistant gets stable, bounded data instead of the whole component tree.
steps.bodyZh: 页面标记业务区域与记录，助手得到稳定且有边界的数据，而不是整个组件树。

steps.title: Mount the guide in the conversation
steps.body: The effect creates the task runtime and a view that switches between the course guide and record-bound task cards. Cleanup removes actions and stops lookups with the page.
steps.bodyZh: effect 创建任务运行时，以及一个在课程引导和记录任务卡之间切换的视图；清理时随页面移除动作并中止查找。

guide.note: The React 16.3 version reaches the same business outcomes through class components and render props, using the legacy adapter entry.
guide.noteZh: React 16.3 版本通过 class 组件、render props 与 legacy 适配器入口达成相同的业务结果。
